(Published by Authority)PART IV (A) - PROVINCIAL COUNCILS
1A
UVA PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments made by the Governor

BY, virtue of powers vested to me by Section 32(1) of the Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987, I, C. Nanda Mathew, Governorof Uva Province do hereby notify that the following appointments have been approved by me .

01.Mr. K. A. B. Senevirathne, Class I officer of the Sri Lanka Engineering Service, to perform the duties of theDeputy Chief Secretary (Engineering Service) for Uva Province in addition to his permanent post, with effectfrom the date 09.09.2014.

02.Mr. K. M. Dissanayake, Class III officer of the Sri Lanka Educational Administrative Service, As Deputy Director(Education ) to the Ministry of Finance and Planning, Law and Peace, Education, Local Government, Land,Cultural Affairs, Social Welfare and Rural Infrastructure Development and Construction for Uva Province.

03.Mr. G. K. S. L. Rajadasa, Class I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to act As Secretary to theMinistry of Agriculture, Irrigation, Animal Production, Inland Fisheries Industry, Transport and Tourism Affairsfor Uva Province, in addition to his permanent post, from the date 10.11.2014 till Mr. Gunadasa Samarasingheresumes his duty after sick leave, who is the Secretary to the Ministry of Agriculture, Irrigation, Animal Production,Inland Fisheries Industry, Transport and Tourism Affairs for Uva Province.

04.Mr. W. M. Nimal Weerasinghe, Retired officer of the Sri Lanka Educational Administrative Service, has been re-appointed on contract basis as Deputy Director to the Education of the Viyaluwa Zonal Education, from the date03.11.2014 till the appointment of a Permanent officer or Up to 02.11.2015.

05.Mr. G. K. S. L Rajadasa, Class I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to act As Deputy Chief Secretary(Administration) for Uva Province, from the date 18.10.2014 to 01.11.2014, till the return of Mrs. R. M. S. D.Rathnayake, to the Island who is the Deputy Chief Secretary (Administration) for Uva Province.

06.Mr. W. M. M. G. Abeysinghe Banda, Class I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to act As Commissionerof Housing for Uva Province, in addition to his permanent post, with effect from the date 20.10.2014.

07.Mr. S. T. Thennakoon, Retired officer of the Non Engineering Service of the Sri Lanka Engineering Service, hasbeen re -appointed on contract basis as Director to Provincial Mechanical for Uva Province, from the date04.11.2014 till the appointment of a permanent officer for above post or Up to 03.11.2015.
08.Mr. W. Randeniya, Class III officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, As Municipal Commissioner ofBadulla Municipal Council, with immediate effect from the date 10.11.2014.

09.Mr. W. M. M. G. Abeysinghe Banda, Class I officer of the Sri Lanka Administrative Service, to act As Secretaryto the Ministry of Health Indigenous Medicine, Probation and childcare and women's Affairs for Uva Province,from the date 21.11.2014 to 26.11.2014, till the return of Mr. Anil Wijesiri, to the Island who is the Secretary to theMinistry of Health, Indigenous Medicine, Probation and Childcare and Women's Affairs for Uva Province.

10.Veterinary Surgeon N. G. C. Y. De Silva, officer of the Sri Lanka Animal Product and Health Service, to perform theduties of the Provincial Director (Uva) to the Department of Animal Product and Health for Uva Province, fromthe date 29.11.2014 to 06.12.2014, till the return of Mr. R. M. Ariyadasa, to the Island who is the ProvincialDirector (Uva) to the Department of Animal Product and Health for Uva Province.

11.Mr. H. K. P. Jayalath, officer of the Sri Lanka Agricultural Service, to perform the duties of the ProvincialAgricultural Director (Uva) to the Department of Agriculture for Uva Province, from the date 29.11.2014 to06.12.2014, till the return of Mr. R. M. Nandasiri, to the Island who is the Provincial Agricultural Director (Uva)to the Department of Agriculture for Uva Province.
C. NANDA MATHEW, Governor of Uva Province.22nd December 2014,Office of the Uva Governor.
